name: unity-drop-api
description: Production-grade Node.js backend for Unity Drop Blood Donation Management System. Featuring serverless/traditional deployment logic, secured JWT authentication, and optimized MongoDB indexing.

unityDrop.mission: To provide a secure, real-time lifeline for blood seekers using advanced matching algorithms.
unityDrop.problem: Manual blood donation processes are slow and prone to errors, leading to life-threatening delays.
unityDrop.solution: An automated, secured Node.js backend that handles real-time donor-patient matching and email-based communication.
unityDrop.impact: Reduces the 'time-to-matching' significantly through a high-performance MongoDB indexing architecture.
